item.title: 【SD Live Performances】Woodstock 94 - The Movie (Laserdisc Transfer, h265)
item.description:
Here is my personal transfer of my Woodstock 94 laserdisc.
95% of this movie is in widescreen, there were some interview shots where there was a psychedelic effect put into the black bars area. In order to make this palatable for modern displays I have decided to crop that stuff out and keep the widescreen presentation.

Pioneer CLD-D504 Laserdisc -> Panasonic DMR-EZ48v - as composite passthough> HDMI out -> huffyuv -> NeatVideo to remove color distortion -> 540p h265 .mp4 / 192kbps 48khz AAC
